utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I still haven’t heard the final count, Rey—last I heard they’re focusing on the porch steps and fence first, with Dan bringing a drill and Rosa covering the rest of the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—if the tools are covered, I could help out wherever they need an extra pair of hands. Do you know who’s actually coordinating people?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t know who’s coordinating people yet—Mina’s been the one asking the most about timing and supplies, so she might know once they lock the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I think Mara’s coordinating the volunteers, but don’t quote me—maybe check with her about the small appliances table and the bikes too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll check with Mara about volunteers, the small appliances table, and the bikes, and I’ll let folks know Cleo’s in to help track tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that helps a lot—thanks, Vik. I’m pretty sure the tools table was the other gap, but I might be mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—Gus is bringing the drill and sawhorses, and I think maybe his level too. I keep having to remind myself who’s got what for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know—Rosa said we still need two fix-it table helpers and one check-in person, with volunteers there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, right—that helps, thanks. I’ll make a note we still need two table helpers and a check-in person by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m bringing the drill and sawhorses, and I can toss in my level too if that’d make things easier for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Gus. Let’s plan to set everything out by eight so folks know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll have the drill, sawhorses, and level there by eight so setup goes smooth.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Quinn, I’m planning to slot Faye into a midday shift for the repair drive, between school pickup and drop-off, once we confirm the exact window.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mara—that midday slot sounds great for Faye, so let’s lock the exact window as soon as we can and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll confirm the exact midday window with Faye and let you know so we can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I heard they’re still collecting supplies this weekend, but I’m planning to check with Sam to make sure the timing hasn’t changed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—Sam’s starting with the folding tables and tool bins by the community center lot, so if the timing changed, let me know and I’ll update my notes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—I’ll check with Sam and pass it along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, we still need two fix-it table helpers and one person for check-in, and I’m asking volunteers to arrive by 9:30 so we’re ready by 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m definitely in, Rosa—I can handle check-in and keep track of the tools and supplies people bring, and I’ll be there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Cleo—thank you for taking check-in, and I really appreciate you keeping an eye on the tools and supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it secondhand from Sam, but I think they’re still collecting supplies this weekend—do you know if that’s right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That matches what I’ve heard, but who’s actually confirming the supply list, and are they set on the porch steps first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure either—I only got it from Sam, so I’d want to check with them before I say anything definite about the supply list or where to leave it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, exactly—I just want to make sure we’re settled on small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics before we share it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that sounds right to me—small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics, and we can stick with that once we’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, then let’s treat that as the working list and do one last check before we announce it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, I’ll spread the word that extension cords, power strips, screwdrivers, and spare parts are the priority so we cover the basics first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect—let’s write that list down clearly before you send it, so we don’t get duplicates and miss something important.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll jot it down neatly first, then I’ll pass it along so everyone knows exactly what’s most useful to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still in—just shoot me the basics on what needs fixing and who’s bringing tools, and I’ll show up with my toolbox if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to pitch in too, Bo—if we can pin down the exact window, I can work it around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—once someone locks the time and the main fixes, send it over and I’ll plan to be there with my toolbox if we still need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Kira, I’m starting with the folding tables and tool bins by the community center lot, and I’ll call out anything broken or missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm the repair list once you’ve checked, and who besides Bo is actually bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep—I’ll confirm the repair list after I check the tables and bins, and I’ll ask Opal who else besides Bo is bringing tools.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
